name: Solomons Porch
overview: Solomon's Porch was a significant part of the outer courtyard of the temple where Jesus walked and taught, as noted in John 10:23. This location also served as a gathering place for early believers and those witnessing the apostles' ministry, as seen in Acts 3:11 and Acts 5:12. The unity and power of the early church were evident in Solomon's Porch, where signs and wonders were performed and believers met with one accord.
